# representable parameter

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:representableParameter`](gmeow-representableParameter.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/representableParameter>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A parameter that this notation system can represent without loss (e.g. pitch in a 12-EDO-aware staff notation). Range is kept open in the core framework; domain-specific slices restrict it to their parameter vocabularies.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md) -> [`owl:Thing`](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:representableParameter`](gmeow-representableParameter.md) from [`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md) to [`owl:Thing`](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a projection profile to enumerate a canonical parameter the notation carries faithfully — pitch, duration, dynamics — so the completeness gate can confirm every parameter is either represented here or accounted for as a loss.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a parameter the notation drops or approximates (that is [`gmeow:declaredLoss`](gmeow-declaredLoss.md) with [`gmeow:accountsForParameter`](gmeow-accountsForParameter.md)) and avoid leaving a known parameter neither represented nor accounted-for — the gate flags that gap.

### How to use

- List each losslessly-carried parameter on the profile via [`gmeow:representableParameter`](gmeow-representableParameter.md); domain slices restrict its open range to their own parameter vocabulary.

### Examples

- ex:staffProfile [`gmeow:representableParameter`](gmeow-representableParameter.md) ex:pitch.
